d.ko: Rounds is a 1v1 rogue-lite shooter where each round gets more intense. The losing player of each round unlocks clever upgrades to create a better build to counter their opponent.
d.en: Rounds is a 1v1 rogue-lite shooter where each round gets more intense. The losing player of each round unlocks clever upgrades to create a better build to counter their opponent.
d.zh: 《Rounds/回合决斗》是一款1v1的肉鸽射击游戏，每过一个回合都会越发激烈。每回合落败的玩家都会解锁创意无限的升级，便于打造更好的构筑反败为胜。

rv.t: 이런 게임의 재미는 ㅄ 같은 능력들만 골랐는데 ㅈ 사기 빌드가 되서 친구를 ㅈ바를때가 가장 짜릿하고 재밌다.
다들 감춰오던 인간군상의 인내와 욕망의 끝을 볼 수 있는 군중철학적인 영화
1대1밖에 안되는 게임이 어딨냐 친구들이랑 하지말란거아님? 기본적으로 되게 만들어줘야지

If monkeys could talk, this would be the game they would eat. Eating, by the way, is very delicious, if you didn't know. This game has no eating whatsoever. That's why I play this game. Or else I might get daibtees.
I choose cards. I make my gun powerful. I shoot an atom bomb. Then all my friends get obliterated into dust. This is a great game.
Honestly, the game is very simple, and is really great honestly. The gameplay is fun, and the areas to fight are good. Although, there is one thing I really don't like about it. …
可匹配可联机的1v1肉鸽射击游戏。 就目前这个游戏现状来说，单人在线匹配应该是很难匹配到人的，联机和朋友玩虽然挺有意思，但掉线率实在太高了，基本玩两三局就得重联，开加速器也基本没改进，这就有点离谱。 …
好玩，失败就拿到武器卡，就是匹配人太难😭
